name: RQ Redis Queue (Python OSS)
free_limit: BSD-2-Clause-licensed Python job queue and worker library for Redis or Valkey with background execution, scheduled jobs and prioritized queues; no software-imposed monthly job, worker or queue limit.
watch_out: Requires a self-operated Redis >=5 or Valkey >=7.2 broker and Python workers; server, compute, persistence, backups, monitoring and networking are not included. This is not a free managed Redis service; paid Tidelift support is separate.
